description: Blast radius of a recorded ChangeEvent along the golden thread. Returns a summary (counts by distance, the distance-1 ring, risk crossings); pass full=true for every impacted node with its hop chain. ALSO READS THE EDGES' OWN PROSE: `stale_edge_evidence` names edges whose `evidence` or `note` still uses language the changed node has DROPPED — the case where a reader following an edge is misled by text that reads as current. It is lexical, never a refusal, and it says so; a node with no snapshot gets a `coverage_note` saying the check was SILENT about its edges rather than clean on them. Ask for this when you want to know what a change will break downstream — the blast radius of a change you recorded.

budget_chars.description:
How many characters of JSON this reply may spend (default 30,000), the
same bound `propagate_from` keeps. Over budget, whole rows are withheld
from the end of `impacted`, the redo list's groups and the other lists,
each named by id in `budget.lists_shortened`; no row shown is cut and
every count stays. The edge-prose notes ride inside the budget.

full.description:
`true` returns every impacted node with its full hop chain. The default
is a summary — counts by distance, the distance-1 ring, risk crossings —
because the full dump on a large design overflows what a session can
read, and every band is still counted in the summary.

offset.description:
With `full: true`: where in `impacted` to start — pass the reply's
`impacted_page.next_offset` to read the radius on, page by page, until
it is null. Refused without `full`, whose summary has no rows to page.

name: propagate_change
title: Blast Radius of a Change
